goalOneSentence: Inventory the existing inventory.qaas.yaml against the premade sut-profile.md and produce a per-test behavioral inventory plus a coverage-gap table — no new YAML files.

tasks.title: Inventory existing tests and identify coverage gaps
tasks.description:
The working directory contains two seeded files: (1) existing-tests/inventory.qaas.yaml — a complete valid QaaS runner YAML testing GET /inventory/items; (2) qaas-analysis/sut-profile.md — a pre-populated SUT profile listing all 3 HTTP surfaces of the InventoryApi: GET /inventory/items, GET /inventory/items/{id}, POST /inventory/reserve. Your task is analysis only. Produce exactly two output files:

**File 1: qaas-analysis/test-inventory.md** — Per-test behavioral inventory. Read the existing inventory.qaas.yaml carefully and produce a Markdown table with columns: Test Name (session+transaction name), Session, Transaction, Route Tested, HTTP Method, Assertions, Hermetic Guard (Yes/No). For each assertion, list its assertion type name and key configuration. Mark the HermeticByExpectedOutputCount assertion explicitly — write 'HermeticByExpectedOutputCount (ExpectedCount=1)' in the Assertions column. There will be exactly one test (ListAllItems in InventoryItemsSession). The hermetic guard MUST be marked Yes.

**File 2: qaas-analysis/coverage-gaps.md** — Gap analysis. Produce a Markdown table with columns: SUT Surface, Route, HTTP Method, Coverage Status, Priority, QaaS Artifact Needed. Map each of the 3 SUT surfaces against the existing tests: (a) GET /inventory/items — COVERED (by the existing InventoryItemsSession/ListAllItems test); (b) GET /inventory/items/{id} — UNCOVERED — Priority: High — needs a new Transaction in a new session (or the existing session) that exercises the path parameter with a known item ID and an unknown item ID (404 case); (c) POST /inventory/reserve — UNCOVERED — Priority: High — needs a new Transaction targeting the reserve route with a valid ReserveRequest body, plus assertions on response body fields (reserved, remaining). For uncovered surfaces, note in the QaaS Artifact Needed column whether a new Transaction in the existing session is sufficient, or whether a new session file is recommended.

Do NOT create any .qaas.yaml, .mocker.yaml, or .csproj files. Analysis markdown only. The verify step will check that exactly 1 .qaas.yaml file exists (the seeded one) — do not create more.
acceptanceCriteria: qaas-analysis/test-inventory.md exists with correct inventory of the existing YAML
HermeticByExpectedOutputCount guard marked Yes in test-inventory.md
rubric: test-inventory.md lists the correct session, transaction, route, and assertions from the seeded YAML
HermeticByExpectedOutputCount marked as hermetic guard in test-inventory.md
coverage-gaps.md has both /items/{id} and /reserve marked as UNCOVERED gaps
No new .qaas.yaml files created — analysis only
failureModes: Creating a new inventory.qaas.yaml with additional tests (violates nonGoals)
Marking all surfaces as uncovered without reading the seeded YAML
Missing HermeticByExpectedOutputCount from the test-inventory.md table
Omitting the QaaS Artifact Needed column in coverage-gaps.md
